descripcion_geo: Region in the north of Greece, between Mounts Olympus and Pindus and the Aegean coast. Homeland of Alexander the Great and first European region evangelized by Paul.
importancia_estrategica: Hellenistic kingdom that expanded Greek culture throughout the known world; in the NT, the first European soil of the gospel.

historias.descripcion: In Troad Paul has a vision of a Macedonian who says 'Come over to Macedonia and help us'; the gospel crosses Europe.
Paul praises the generosity of the Macedonians (Philippians and Thessalonica) who gave to the poor of Jerusalem despite their own poverty.
Imprisoned in Philippi, Paul and Silas sing hymns; An earthquake opens the doors and the jailer converts.

personajes.descripcion: He brought the gospel to Macedonia in response to the vision; He founded churches in Philippi, Thessalonica and Berea.
He conquered the known world and spread Greek as a lingua franca, preparing the ground for the NT.
Born in Thyatira, established in Philippi (Macedonia); first baptized on European soil.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Land of Hellenism; in the NT, the soil where the gospel made the leap from Asia to Europe, fulfilling the vision of the Macedonian.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: The Macedonian's vision in Troad redirected the Pauline mission from Asia to Europe; The Western Church was born in Macedonia.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: The Macedonian's vision in Troad redirected the Pauline mission from Asia to Europe; The Western Church was born in Macedonia.

historias.titulo: Paul founds the first European church in Philippi
historias.descripcion: By the river at Philippi, Paul preaches to Lydia and her household; The first Christian community in Europe is born.

historias.titulo: The Letters to the Thessalonians: Early Epistles of the NT
historias.descripcion: Paul writes from Corinth to the church of Thessalonica: the oldest letters of the NT.
The poor churches of Macedonia give generously to the saints of Jerusalem, being a model of liberality.

personajes.descripcion: Macedonia evangelized; He founded the churches of Philippi, Thessalonica and Berea.
Partner of Paul in the evangelization of Macedonia.
Merchant from Thyatira baptized in Philippi of Macedonia.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Macedonia was the first European territory where the gospel took deep roots.

cristianismo.fuente_primaria: Nuevo Testamento / Padres de la Iglesia
cristianismo.descripcion: A night vision redirected Paul's mission from Asia to Macedonia; axial moment of Christian history.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: A night vision redirected Paul's mission from Asia to Macedonia; axial moment of Christian history.
